instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, close-up shot, shows a couple embracing in a snowy winter forest. The woman in the grey beanie (R1) stands on the right, wearing a black leather jacket and white mittens, smiling gently with her eyes open. She wraps her arms from behind around the man in the black beanie (R2), who stands on the left in a brown coat with his back partially turned. The background is filled with soft, snow-covered trees. The lighting is diffused and cool, highlighting the falling snow and creating a serene, romantic winter mood.
elements: R1 wraps her arms around R2 from behind
R2 is the person being encircled from behind by R1's arms
R1 is the rear embracing participant while R2 has his back partially turned
